page.overview:
Who is Musarin?

Musarin is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is tall and aging. She has white hair., Musarin}} Her hair color implies she is significantly more than two hundred years old.

She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air. Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
